Add PRE2DUP drug use periods to skeleton

Source: R/add_rxpre2dup.R
add_rxpre2dup.Rd

Runs PRE2DUP on the LMED dispensings that match each code list, and adds one logical column per code list to the skeleton. A column is TRUE on every week or annual row that overlaps a drug use period, and FALSE elsewhere.

Usage

add_rxpre2dup(
  skeleton,
  lmed,
  hosp = NULL,
  id_name = "lopnr",
  codes,
  design,
  atc_parameters = swereg::pre2dup_atc_parameters,
  ...
)

Arguments

skeleton

A data.table created by create_skeleton().

lmed

A data.table of LMED dispensings, with the columns id_name, edatum (Date), atc, produkt, lnmn and fddd.

hosp

A data.table of hospital stays, with the columns id_name, indatum (Date) and utdatum (Date), or NULL. Stays with utdatum <= indatum are dropped.

id_name

The name of the person id column in lmed and hosp.

codes

A named list of ATC patterns, as in add_rx() with source = "atc". Every name MUST start with rxpre2dup_. A pattern matches every ATC code that starts with it. A pattern that starts with "!" excludes the codes that start with the rest of it.

design

A data.table returned by rxpre2dup_read_design().

atc_parameters

The ATC-level parameters of PRE2DUP, with the columns of pre2dup_atc_parameters.

...

The global arguments of PRE2DUP, passed to the PRE2DUP run: global_gap_max, global_min, global_max, global_max_single, global_ddd_high, global_hosp_max, days_covered, weight_past, weight_current, weight_next, weight_first_last and post_process_perc.

Value

The skeleton, invisibly. The function adds the columns by reference, and it grows the column allocation as add_rx() does.

The attribute package_coverage of the skeleton is a data.table with one row per code list and ATC code. Its columns are name, atc, n_purchases and share_without_package. The share counts the purchases with no design row, after PRE2DUP adds the dispensings of one package on one day together. One message line shows each share.

Dispensings

A dispensing matches a design row when atc, produkt and tolower(trimws(lnmn)) are equal and abs(fddd - pack_ddd) < 0.005. Every dispensing enters PRE2DUP with ratio = 1 and ddd = fddd. A dispensing with no design row uses the ATC-level rule of PRE2DUP, with the parameters of atc_parameters.

Rows of lmed whose fddd is missing, not finite or negative are dropped. A row with fddd = 0 is kept and enters PRE2DUP with ddd = 0. Such a row matches no design row.

Periods on the skeleton

Each code list gets its own PRE2DUP run, on the dispensings whose ATC code matches it. Each period becomes the closed interval from its start date to its end date. add_rx() then maps these intervals to the skeleton, with the period dates as start_date and stop_date. Weekly and annual rows therefore behave exactly as in add_rx().

See also

rxpre2dup_read_design(), add_rx(), pre2dup_atc_parameters
